facts.fact: 他醒来时坐在 Inhuman Resources 候诊室，皮沙发上身体里涌着肾上腺素，还带着一个多世纪以来最强烈的一次勃起。
facts.anchor: the largest erection I’ve had in over a century

facts.fact: Agency 在他执行任务期间把他召回了——这是干预 Reaper 任务、且不等季度考核的手段。
facts.anchor: The Agency recalled me while on assignment.

facts.fact: IR 代表翻着《Reaper Handbook》指出，他近期行为可能违反了第 417 条。
facts.anchor: you may be in violation Rule 417

facts.fact: 第 417 条原文：Reaper 严禁对自己负责的灵魂产生依恋，工作全程必须不动感情。
facts.anchor: Reapers are expressly forbidden from forming attachments with their assigned souls. They must be dispassionate about their work at all times.

facts.fact: 他两天前提交的观察备忘录抬头是「Lucy McKenzie—Observation Notes #4」，问卷要求六句以内回答她如何应对不确定。
备忘录正文写道：Lucy 应对不确定性的方式并非都健康，许多与拿铁和给猫网购衣服有关。
facts.anchor: Not all of her coping mechanisms are healthy. Many seem to involve cappuccinos and ordering outfits online for her cat.

facts.fact: IR 代表要他保持职业界限，他口头答应——原文点明这是谎话。
结尾他自省：对 Agency 撒谎已经变得太容易了，这件事本身该让他警觉。
facts.anchor: I should be concerned, really, about how easy lying to the Agency has become.
